channel.title: MediaToday Co Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Senior lecturer wins right to monthly €680 ICT allowance in MCAST case
item.description: MCAST’s appeal against the Industrial Tribunal ruling is rejected, confirming it illegally withheld a monthly bonus from an Engineering Institute lecturer doing comparable work to ICT staff

item.title: Minor admits to school assault as court issues bail conditions
item.description: A 15-year-old student has admitted to punching and throwing a schoolmate to the ground in school. The accused intends to file a counter-report alleging insults and threats made by the alleged victim on previous occasions

item.title: Former St Paul’s Bay councillor charged with domestic violence is granted bail
item.description: Magistrate slams police over inconsistencies involving breaches of protection or restraining orders after accused is arrested not summoned despite allegations revolving around a single email and evidence sourced primarily from a public Facebook post

item.title: Agius Saliba, Zammit Lewis join choir of Labour voices opposing Żabbar elderly home
item.description: PL MP Edward Zammit Lewis further blasts 'insensitive' Planning Authority and calls for local plan change

item.title: Homeless man fined €1,200 after school watchman flags intruder collecting bottles for cash
item.description: Homeless man who entered school grounds illegally to collect refundable bottles handed €1,200 fine and suspended sentence

item.title: Man accused of breaching protection order weeks after sentence
item.description: Man allegedly breaches protection order three weeks after being handed sentence

item.title: Lampuki season extended until end January 2026
item.description: Parliamentary Secretary for Animal Rights Alicia Bugeja Said announces lampuki season will be extended until January 2026

item.title: Man jailed for seven years after setting fire to Ħal Far detention block
item.description: The accused started a fire that left more than 20 others suffering from smoke inhalation

item.title: Moviment Graffitti wants Malta to pull out from Eurovision over Israels participation
item.description: The NGO is once again calling on government to refuse participation in the Eurovision, saying, 'This festival should not serve as an opportunity for Israel to use music to try to cleanse its reputation after the holocaust in Gaza'

item.title: PN remembers Raymond Caruana 39 years after murder
item.description: Nationalist leader Alex Borg stressed the importance of remembering past injustices to ensure they are not repeated
